title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1987-03-26
lineage: Nakamichi 700II (cassette master)> Oade Modified Lunatec V3 @ 24/96> Wave Lab 5 (resample, Apogee uv22hr dither)> CDA> FLAC16
source: (2x) AudioTechnica AT835 + (1x) AKG D12E > Sony TCD5

ai_review.summary: Wild, audience‑charged performance highlighted by a fiery Hell in a Bucket; recording quality not detailed but presumed adequate.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the high energy of this show – the crowd clapped from floor to balcony and erupted when Garcia launched his first solo. The standout moment cited is an impromptu “Hell in a Bucket” that sent the audience into a frenzy. No specific recording‑quality comments were made, so the source is unknown but likely acceptable for listening.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive feedback on performance (70% weight) and no reported recording problems (30% weight) lead to a high overall rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on sound clarity, mix, or source; only audience atmosphere is described.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set sparked continuous excitement, with the crowd responding wildly from start to intermission and a memorable spontaneous jam of Hell in a Bucket.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia stepped back for his first solo, gave it a little kick, and ignited the audience.
